changes.comment: sdk-backend-tiger: Keep hour, minute and second date attribute values as the backend computed them around daylight saving transitions; `normalizedValue` now carries the value in UTC in every browser timezone; custom `dateFormatter` and `dateStringifier` implementations of `TigerBackendConfig` receive a Date carrying the value in its UTC fields, and custom `dateNormalizer` implementations must return an ISO string carrying it in UTC
sdk-ui-dashboard: Show and shift the key driver analysis period in UTC so the browser timezone does not change it
